property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the ClipboardPreference (a Application).

property.name: preferStyledTextWhenPasting
property.shortdesc: If true, includes text attributes when pasting text.

property.name: preferPDFWhenPasting
property.shortdesc: If true, pastes PDF if available.

property.name: copyPDFToClipboard
property.shortdesc: If true, copies PDF to the clipboard.

property.name: pasteRemembersLayers
property.shortdesc: If true, objects cut or copied from different layers retain their layer assignment when pasted.

property.name: showAutoStyleOption
property.shortdesc: If true, show auto style option.

property.name: preservePdfClipboardAtQuit
property.shortdesc: If true, preserves PDF data on the system clipboard when the application exits.

property.name: showPasteOptions
property.shortdesc: If true, show paste options on paste.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the ClipboardPreference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
